contract_change_proposals.change: Replace the single-blob sketch with per-slot SaveRecord rows (core, settings, story:auto/1/2/3, sandbox, mode:*, mod:*), each with its own schema version, generation and checksum. SaveGame becomes an assembled read model. missionsDone[] becomes missions{state,bestSec,medals}, and npcRelations moves into the story slice.
contract_change_proposals.why: Atomic per-slice writes, LWW cloud sync per slot (S09) and the Grand-V Story/Sandbox namespace separation need independent records; a single checksum over one blob cannot support them.

contract_change_proposals.change: Widen IN `buttons` from u16 to u32 (+2 B); InputFrame carries 19 SimButton bits today. The `tick` field stays u32 and the input quantization matches IN exactly.
contract_change_proposals.why: Bits 16–18 (Respray, Emote, PhoneQuick) and future sim actions do not fit in u16; S01 ordered the bits so the first 16 are the net-critical set in the meantime.

contract_change_proposals.change: Assumed chunk fields: collision {heightfield, building prisms}; tags {hidingSpots, pursuitBreakers, chokePoints, jumpZones, portals, shoreNodes}; road graph usable by A* for police dispatch; ambient spawn tables keyed by (cellKey, slot) with per-tier densityCap so lower tiers run a prefix of slots.
contract_change_proposals.why: The physics working set, PursuitDirector, swim respawn and cross-tier/cross-client ambient determinism (DO-owned traffic from seed) depend on these.

contract_change_proposals.change: Assumed TierProfile exposes physicsRadiusM, ambientCaps {cars, peds}, animBands, audioVoices and ragdollCap. S01 proposes Quest 150 m and Vision Pro 200 m physics radii plus the animation, voice and ragdoll values in 01-engine.md §6 for S11 to confirm.
contract_change_proposals.why: The research budgets give physics radius only for desktop and mobile tiers, and give no animation-band or voice figures.

contract_change_proposals.change: Mission IR resolves lat/lng and landmark zones to ENU ZoneShape at load. Interpreter threads run on SimScheduler (2,000 ops per thread per tick). Mode hooks call ModeContext.startChild. A hook whose mode requires the canonical profile under a local parent falls back to its stub. Mission checkpoints are {schema, data} owned by S03.
contract_change_proposals.why: Keeps A-02 hooks deterministic and lets the C05 story slice store S03 checkpoints opaquely.

decisions_needed.question: Load one Rapier build per session (restart sim.worker to switch profiles) or ship both builds and switch live?
decisions_needed.recommendation: One build per session; switch only at top-level mode entry behind the loading screen; measure restart cost in M01a (Q-ENG-01).

decisions_needed.question: Should free-roam story also use deterministic-compat so every session is cross-browser reproducible?
decisions_needed.recommendation: No, keep D-12 (simd-compat for local play); revisit if M03a shows deterministic-compat within 10% tick cost.

decisions_needed.question: Save size caps.
decisions_needed.recommendation: 2 MiB per slot record, 16 MiB per profile, 64 profiles, names 1–80 chars, keep 2 generations per slot.

decisions_needed.question: In-game clock rate.
decisions_needed.recommendation: 30 game seconds per real second (48-minute day), tunable in config/clock.json.

decisions_needed.question: Run the multiplayer socket in sim.worker or on the main thread?
decisions_needed.recommendation: sim.worker, with a main-thread MessagePort relay fallback if iOS workers lack WebSocket (decide in M12a).

decisions_needed.question: XR player body in v1.
decisions_needed.recommendation: Hands only with forearm IK; full-body IK via a post-M11b ADR.

decisions_needed.question: Skateboard/scooter controller (Q-MOD-06).
decisions_needed.recommendation: Out of v1.

contract_change_proposals.change: Replace the 06 v0.95 sketch with C13 v1.0.0 (spec/domains/11-platform.md section 4): QualityTierId = desktop-ultra | desktop | mobile | mobile-low | xr-quest | xr-visionpro (research names xr-standalone/xr-pro renamed per the brief); budgets in render objects; per-pass XR values; FLAT_LADDER, FLAT_TIER_OF, VARIANT_FALLBACK, DeviceProfile, TierDecision, QualityService.
contract_change_proposals.why: Brief requires six tiers; D-09 budgets in render objects; S05 already imports these ids.

contract_change_proposals.change: Variants keyed by QualityTierId with C13 VARIANT_FALLBACK; every asset must resolve for all six tiers (check:assets); each pack/variant carries SHA-256 hash (OPFS store verifies on write) and a kind; KTX2 variants are resolution classes, not GPU formats.
contract_change_proposals.why: WorldPackStore is content-addressed; S05 05-assets.md already assumes this.

contract_change_proposals.change: FrameSignal is sent on every main-thread rAF or XR frame even when FramePacer skips the draw (30 fps tiers); add SimServices.xrPoses reading the seqlocked XrPoseBlock (part B 4.3).
contract_change_proposals.why: XR poses exist only on the Window; sim.worker needs them for wheel grab, punches and teleport validity.

contract_change_proposals.change: The three XR Binders (xr-controller, xr-hand, xr-transient) are thin readers over S11's XrInputRouter per-frame cache and never sample XRFrame themselves; Quest face-button indices come from config/xr-input-profiles.json captured on device.
contract_change_proposals.why: XRFrame is valid only inside the frame callback; routing must be by XRInputSource identity.

contract_change_proposals.change: Replace QualityTierRef (old tier names, level) with QualityTierId; XRRigParams.session 'immersive-ar' not available in v1; answer to rule 3: reversedDepthBuffer on all tiers, RendererHost.depthPolicy published, rig raises near to max(near, far/20000) when 'standard'; XR mode exposes only a dolly (no shake, no camera collision push, head-in-geometry fades).
contract_change_proposals.why: Consistency with C13 and XR comfort rules; immersive-ar on visionOS is UNVERIFIED.

contract_change_proposals.change: Embed PlatformSettings (v1: tierOverride, compatibilityMode, fpsCap, renderScale, foveation, dataSaver, xr: XrComfortSettings) under settings.platform; TierDecision stays in IndexedDB, not in the save.
contract_change_proposals.why: R-UI-02 settings page needs persisted platform choices; tier decisions are per-device.

contract_change_proposals.change: Add events tier.decision{tier,source,benchP90Ms} and storage.persist{granted}; app.start props nav, coi, store, backend, tier; deviceClass values iphone|ipad|android|desktop|quest|avp already match C13 DeviceClass.
contract_change_proposals.why: Client telemetry and abnormal-exit demotion need them.

contract_change_proposals.change: Chunks stay within 6 render objects, one BundleGroup per chunk, static = true; optional teleportNodes[] per chunk for XR on stairs and steep hills; far-field representation per tier (impostor ring 80 km desktop, skyline cards otherwise).
contract_change_proposals.why: D-09, D-15, XR locomotion on SF hills.

contract_change_proposals.change: CutscenePlayer reuses S11 FirstGestureUnlock (pool of 3 video elements, AudioContext) and XrMediaHost implementations (Quest media layer, Vision Pro VideoFrameTexture, texture fallback); DOM-overlay hosts pause the render loop.
contract_change_proposals.why: D-20 platform side.

decisions_needed.question: Who flips webgpu.mobile in config/platform-flags.json and on what evidence?
decisions_needed.recommendation: Flip only after the M01c iPhone 15 Home Screen run passes (30 min, no jetsam, p90 inside budget); re-validate in M11a; until then mobile tiers use the WebGL2 backend.

decisions_needed.question: Is a postMessage fallback transport required in v1 when crossOriginIsolated is false?
decisions_needed.recommendation: Yes, minimal single-switch transport without perf guarantees, so the game degrades instead of failing.

decisions_needed.question: How is XR UI rendered (DOM cannot appear in XR)?
decisions_needed.recommendation: Canvas 2D panels through a shared UiSurface from S10, drawn to quad layers on Quest and textured planes on Vision Pro.

decisions_needed.question: Split M01b and add an asset-worker milestone?
decisions_needed.recommendation: Split M01b into M01b (controller, cameras, touch) and M01c (device spike, RendererHost, tier selection, perf HUD, heartbeat); add M02a2 (asset.worker + OPFS WorldPackStore) before M02b; give the cutscene-playback spike an id before M05b.

decisions_needed.question: Auto-promotion to desktop-ultra?
decisions_needed.recommendation: Only on WebGPU with a non-fallback adapter and benchmark p90 <= 8.35 ms at desktop settings, otherwise manual; ultra and other dagger numbers are extrapolations to calibrate in M11a.

decisions_needed.question: Support level for PC VR / Quest Link?
decisions_needed.recommendation: Best effort on the xr-quest profile, not in acceptance.

decisions_needed.question: Request hand-tracking at XR entry on Vision Pro?
decisions_needed.recommendation: Yes as an optional feature at entry (single permission prompt); denial leaves gaze-and-pinch.

decisions_needed.question: Which physical test devices exist (iPhone 15, iPhone 16/17, Quest 3 and 3S, Vision Pro, Windows laptop and discrete-GPU desktop)?
decisions_needed.recommendation: Owner confirms the minimum set iPhone 15 + iPhone 16/17 + Quest 3 + Vision Pro; mark desktop-ultra and weak-desktop calibration unverified if Windows hardware is unavailable.

contract_change_proposals.change: SaveGame must carry saveProfileId (32-hex), namespace 'story'|'sandbox', slot id, client mtime (ms), schema version, and sha256 checksum; inline size ≤ 256 KiB (larger goes to R2 blob)
contract_change_proposals.why: Cloud sync uses optimistic versions, tombstones and Grand-V save-profile rules (≤ 64 profiles) [research/repos-grand-v.md (d)]

contract_change_proposals.change: The 06 v0.95 uniform envelope {t, seq, tick, payload} is replaced by per-type binary layouts (IN/SNAP/EV/ACK/BYE/ACT/CHAT) with a 1-byte type; JSON only for welcome/handoff/notice/kick; snapshot rate fixed at 20 Hz
contract_change_proposals.why: Binary per-type frames keep IN at ~44 B and SNAP at 28 B per entity; a uniform envelope wastes bytes at 20 Hz [research/stack-cloudflare-backend.md §4.5]; A-04 fixes 20 Hz

contract_change_proposals.change: ExperienceDescriptor.anchor must carry both {lat,lng} and chunkKey; radius ≤ 250 m; moderation/visibility fields are server-owned and read-only to clients
contract_change_proposals.why: Map queries index by chunk key; anchor rules check lat/lng against SF land, right-of-way and parcels [research/auth-ugc-input-maps.md §3.4]

contract_change_proposals.change: Assumption: the mod runtime exposes modsActive(): boolean so the room client can send it in rooms/assign; publish validation requires a closed permissions[] enum and a provenance block
contract_change_proposals.why: Mods are disabled in multiplayer (D-26, close 4007); the publish scanner fails closed on unknown permissions [research/gap-trust-safety-tooling.md §4.2]

contract_change_proposals.change: Assumption: C02 netIn/netOut phases run where the sim tick counter and the local input buffer are available (sim.worker per D-08); C03 provides a ≤16-bit wire button bitset table owned by S01; S01 owns an AnimStateId (u8) registry
